changelog:
Gate receipts and safe test reuse, big-file secret scanning, Windows fixes, no memory cap.

Features: gate.js writes a receipt for every run (tree hash at start and end, HEAD, mode, config and engine identity, per-project results); verify-receipt [--mode full] [--json] checks that a passing receipt covers the exact current tree. Per-project reuse: a test project listed in test.projects with reuse: true is skipped when its input closure (sources, project references followed transitively, Directory.Build.*, package and SDK files, gate config, engine) is byte-identical to its last clean pass; a static scan vetoes reuse for projects that read files at test time unless they declare inputs, and receipts.maxAgeHours (24) and forceRunEvery (5) force a fresh run. `gate.js full` runs everything; `gate.js stop` stops a running gate cooperatively; --help prints usage and unknown flags exit 2. pull-request.js refuses to open a PR without a full passing receipt when receipts.requireFullForPr is true. A tree that changes mid-run makes the receipt invalid, and fails the gate where receipts are in use. On Linux and macOS test stages run as stoppable child processes. Secret scanner: input over 24 KB and files over 100 KB are scanned in overlapping line-snapped windows, so a secret on an engine chunk cut is no longer missed; redaction is linear. A value-sha256 entry in .betterleaksignore clears one reviewed generic value (never a named provider key), and a UTF-16 file written by PowerShell 5.1 is read. Memory: a category no longer has a size cap and is never auto-pruned; the memory-guard hook is retired (an unedited copy is removed on update), and lint has 9 checks.

Fixes (Windows): intake publication no longer fails on every write (records are flushed through a file handle; keep intake on an NTFS volume); short 8.3 paths no longer make a project "not its own git root" in the gate, fleet and publish; core.hooksPath=NUL or /dev/null is reported as disabled; commit-guard blocks a PowerShell `git -C <dir> <alias>` that expands to commit --no-verify.

Migration: build output (bin, obj, TestResults, coverage) must be gitignored before turning on receipts, or every run is invalid. Reuse is opt-in per project; with no test.projects the gate behaves as before. MEMORY_MAX_PER_CATEGORY overrides are now inert.

--- v6.11 ---
Secret scanner: value-sha256 entries in .betterleaksignore clear one reviewed value across pushed history

--- v6.10 ---
v6.10 — lessons from a 1,400-memory store: a killed gate is not a failed one, memory lint for in-place corrections, and recall tuning for large stores.

Features: MEMORY_RECALL_KW_SCORE (0.25-4, default 1.75) tunes the keyword-only recall gate; on a 1,400-memory store the default kept a useful memory for 5 of 28 prompts that had one, and 1.0 kept 12. The CLI recall now honors MEMORY_RECALL_FLOOR too. MEMORY_CAPTURE_PROVIDER takes a fallback chain (claude-cli,anthropic): each provider is tried in order, the reason one was skipped is logged, and status lists the chain. memory-manager.js lint gains four checks: corrected_in_place (a body that says CORRECTED/OBSOLETE, or keeps the old claim in a correction or historical_* field, instead of being superseded), id_drift (an id whose words no longer appear in its body), schema_drift (no description or summary, importance off the 1-5 scale), and see_also links in broken_refs. Recall now reads rejected alternatives[], wrong_pattern, why and how_to_apply, and memories that keep their text under pattern or content. Skills: qa-engineer adds what a passing test can and cannot prove (one injected defect, vacuous helpers, fake data providers, production-shaped fixtures) and more implementation-coupled patterns under What NOT to Test; verification-before-completion adds stale builds, later-step guards, KILLED vs FAILED, counting units and late agent reports; code-review adds reviewer independence, $-anchored allowlists and completeness counted in the wrong unit; todo flags shared state beyond files; architecture warns about in-process schedulers on idling hosts. The fix-every-finding wording in run-todo and verification-before-completion now points at the TEST-GAP exception.

Fixes: gate.js reports a leg stopped by a signal (out-of-memory killer, Node heap abort, CI cancel, Ctrl-C) as KILLED with the signal, not FAILED, and a gate that is itself killed no longer leaves the previous run's verdict in the summary: telemetry records it as unknown with the kill, and status shows KILLED or UNFINISHED. The build leg reports its own timeout.

Migration: none required. Lint scores may drop where a store has in-place corrections or memories without a description; the findings name each one.
